[SWS_CORE_00004] Handling of Corruptions
⌈
If a
Corruption
is detected, it shall
result in unsuccessful process termination, in an implementation-defined way.
⌋
(RS_-
AP_00142)
Note: It can either be abnormal or normal unsuccessful termination, depending on the
implementation's ability to detect the
Corruption
and to react to it by cleaning up
resources.
